Loss report: gitea -> woodpecker
[lost] pipeline/ci display.name (the Woodpecker workflow name is its file name; the display name is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/build ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gha (container) is not written to the Woodpecker file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[external] pipeline/ci/job/build job.runner: no backend label (the hosted label ubuntu-latest runs on any Linux worker; the GitHub-hosted image tools are not present)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.shell: bash-if-present wrapper command (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; Woodpecker runs commands through /bin/sh -e of the image, so one command re-runs the script under bash -e when the image has bash, else under sh -e, and bash-only syntax fails under sh)
